title: Copy and paste a cell
teach: Copy makes a duplicate and leaves the original where it is. Press Ctrl+C on a selected cell, click the destination, then press Ctrl+V.
task: Copy the rate in B1 into D1.
hints: Click B1 so it is selected.
Press Ctrl+C (or the Copy button), then click D1.
limit: Copy and paste work inside Gridwise. Copying between Gridwise and real Excel is not supported.
